definitions.short: Hadoram , a son of Joktan, and the tribe descended from him
definitions.full: H1913. Hadoram הֲדוֺרָם proper name, masculine 1. Arabian tribe, called son of Joktan Gen 10:27 (compare Di) = 1Chr 1:21 ; Glas ii. 435 compare Dauram near ‚ang â in Yemen (Sabean הדרום CIS iv.1. p.1 ; ᵐ5 Ὁδορρα Gen 10:27 , ᵐ5 L Οδορραμ ; 1Chr 1:21 ᵐ5 B omitted by ᵐ5 L Αδωραμ ). 2 son of Tou ( תֹּעוּ ) king of Hamath 1Chr 18:10 ( ᵐ5 Ἱδουρααμ , ᵐ5 L Αθωραμ ); so read probably in || 2Sam 8:10 , for יוֺרָם , compare ᵐ5 Ἰεδδουραν , see We Dr) — הֲדֹרָם . הֲדֹרָם proper name, masculine an official of Rehoboam 2Chr 10:18 ( ᵐ5 Ἀδωνειραμ ) = אֲדֹרָם 1Kin 12:18 ( ᵐ5 Ἀραμ , Ἀδωνιραμ ), & אֲדֹנִירָם q. v. — הֲדוֺרָם .
definitions.rootNote: or הֲדֹרָם ; probably of foreign derivation;

occurrences.englishText: he sent Hadoram his son to king David, to Greet him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
